references.text: The priest shall isolate the sick person for seven days, which is the first inspection period before this second examination on the seventh day.
The same pattern of examination on the seventh day and declaration of cleanliness if the rash has not spread.
Washing of clothes as part of the cleansing ritual after being declared clean from leprosy.
Washing of clothes as a cleansing ritual to become clean, a recurring theme in the laws of purity.
Washing of clothes as part of the cleansing process, parallel to the cleansing ritual in Leviticus.
The priest declares the person clean when the rash has not spread, the same principle as in verse 6.
The priest declares cleanliness when the rash has faded and has not spread, an identical assessment criterion.
